rules.rule_context:
DPO Standing Instruction - Purpose Limitation for Partner Interaction Data

Any data collected on a basis of 'support resolution only' or equivalent DPA tagging falls within the scope of Article 5(1)(b) GDPR purpose limitation. Such data may be processed only for the support purpose originally specified. Reuse for sales targeting, lead scoring, or commercial enrichment constitutes a new purpose and requires a separate legal basis. The test is: if the DPA basis tag at collection was support-origin, the data stays in support scope unless a valid consent or other Article 6 basis has been obtained subsequently and recorded in the consent management system. Data where partner_consent equals 'marketing_ok' or 'sales_approved' is outside this restriction. Masking or hashing identifiers does not cure a purpose breach if the underlying content is still reused for the commercial purpose. Adding derived sales flags or enrichment tags to support-origin data is repurposing regardless of technical processing layer. - M. Voss, Nordstream Logistics DPO
